description: This file contains utility functions for handling environment variables, listing configuration and agent paths, and reading JSON files related to agent configurations and authentication profiles in the openclaw project.

methods.name: parseEnvAssignmentValue
methods.description: Returns the value of an environment variable after parsing it with parseEnvValue.

methods.name: listAuthProfileStorePaths
methods.description: Lists paths to authentication profile stores based on configuration and state directory.

methods.name: listLegacyAuthJsonPaths
methods.description: Finds and returns paths to legacy auth.json files within agent directories.

methods.name: listAgentModelsJsonPaths
methods.description: Generates a list of paths to models.json files for agents, including main and other agents.

methods.name: readJsonObjectIfExists
methods.description: Reads a JSON object from a file if it exists, with options for size and file type validation.
